data.summary:
 Around 8+ years of IT experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-scale AI, cloud, and
data engineering solutions on Microsoft Azure.
Experienced in building enterprise Generative AI applications using OpenAI GPT-4, Azure OpenAI,
LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
Strong expertise in developing intelligent knowledge management and semantic search solutions using
ChromaDB, Azure AI Search, embeddings, and vector search technologies.
Proficient in prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, context management, transformer models, tokenization, and embedding techniques to improve AI application accuracy and performance.  Hands-on experience evaluating and optimizing LLM applications using RAGAS, Cross-Encoder Re- ranking, Maximum Marginal Relevance (MMR), Semantic Caching, and retrieval optimization techniques.
Experienced in developing scalable RESTful APIs and AI-powered microservices using Python, FastAPI,
and cloud-native architectures for enterprise applications.
Strong expertise in designing and implementing large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines using PySpark, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, and SSIS for processing structured and unstructured data.
Proficient in working with SQL Server, Oracle, AWS Athena, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS
Gen2) for enterprise data management, analytics, and reporting.
Skilled in building cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure
Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, and related Azure services.
Experienced in implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices using Docker, Git, GitHub Actions,
and GitLab CI/CD for automated deployment, testing, and version control.
Proficient in developing interactive dashboards and analytical reports using Power BI and Azure Analysis
Services (AAS) to support data-driven business decisions.
Experienced working in Agile/Scrum environments, collaborating with cross-functional teams including business stakeholders, solution architects, data engineers, data scientists, DevOps engineers, and product owners to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance enterprise AI and data solutions.

Professional Experience:
Working as Gen AI Engineer at Dell Technologies, Bengaluru from Nov 2023 to Till Date.  Worked as Senior Technology Consulting at Ernst & Young LLP, Bengaluru from Aug 2022 to Oct 2023.  Worked as Software Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services, Bengaluru from Jan 2018 to May 2022
Project Experience:
Project 3: Client: Dell Duration: Nov 2023 to Till Date.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Designed and developed enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions using OpenAI GPT-4 and Azure
OpenAI to enhance healthcare operations, clinical support, member engagement, provider services, and enterprise knowledge management across Humana Inc.
Built advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications using LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable intelligent retrieval of clinical guidelines, healthcare policies, provider documentation, member resources, care management information, and enterprise knowledge repositories.
Developed semantic search solutions using ChromaDB and embedding-based retrieval techniques to deliver accurate, context-aware search capabilities across clinical documents, provider resources, member information, healthcare policies, and operational knowledge bases.
Engineered scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines using PySpark, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Databricks Delta Lake, and SSIS to process large-scale healthcare, member, provider, clinical, operational, and analytics datasets.
Applied advanced prompt engineering, context management, embeddings, and LLM optimization

techniques to improve AI response accuracy, clinical insights, retrieval performance, and adherence to healthcare compliance standards. Implemented multi-agent AI workflows using CrewAI, LangGraph, and MCP to automate member assistance, provider support, care coordination, clinical documentation assistance, healthcare inquiries, and internal operational workflows.
Developed secure RESTful APIs and AI-powered healthcare applications using Python and FastAPI,
integrating Generative AI capabilities with healthcare platforms, member applications, provider portals, care management systems, and enterprise applications.
Evaluated and optimized AI application performance using RAGAS, Cross-Encoder Re-ranking, Maximum
Marginal Relevance (MMR), Semantic Caching, and embedding optimization to improve retrieval accuracy, response relevance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Managed healthcare data stored in SQL Server, Oracle, AWS Athena, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2) while maintaining data quality, governance, security, privacy, and compliance with HIPAA and healthcare industry standards.
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Docker, and Git to automate
deployment, testing, monitoring, and version control of AI applications and healthcare data engineering solutions.
Developed interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI and Azure Analysis Services
(AAS) to provide insights into member engagement, healthcare analytics, operational performance, care
management metrics, and AI solution effectiveness.
Collaborated with healthcare analysts, clinicians, care management teams, provider networks, data
scientists, enterprise architects, DevOps engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable AI solutions aligned with Humana Inc.'s digital healthcare transformation, member-centered care, and operational excellence initiatives.
Project 2:
Client: Goldman Sachs Duration: Aug 2022 to Oct 2023.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Extensive experience in migrating on-premises data sources to Azure Blob Storage staging areas,
enabling efficient data processing and analysis in the cloud.
Proficient in Azure BI migrations, leveraging Azure Data Factory (ADF) to extract data from various on-
premises systems, including SAP, SQL Server, CSV files, and Blob Storage.
Skilled in creating ADF pipelines with advanced activities such as Lookup, Copy Data, Set Variable, and
Azure Function, ensuring reliable and scalable data movement.
Hands-on experience in executing ADF data migration projects, seamlessly transferring data from on-
premises to Azure cloud services, including Azure SQL Database and Azure Data Lake Storage.  Expertise in configuring and utilizing Azure cloud services, including Azure Blob Storage, Azure SQL
Database, and Azure Data Lake Storage, to build robust data platforms.
Proficient in implementing data warehouse solutions and writing complex SQL queries using joins, keys,
and subqueries to transform and load data into final destinations.
Knowledgeable in using Logic Apps for email configurations within ADF pipelines, enabling effective
monitoring and alerting of data migration processes.
Experienced in working with Agile methodologies, actively participating in daily scrum meetings, sprint
planning, and demo sessions to ensure successful project delivery.
Project 1:
Client: HSBC Duration: Jan 2018 to May 2022.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Designed and optimized complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, functions, and triggers for
efficient data manipulation and reporting.
Developed and maintained ETL workflows using SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) to load data from
multiple sources into the data warehouse.
Performed data validation, cleansing, and transformation using T-SQL and applied indexing techniques
to improve query performance.  Creating Report using SSRS Report.   Maintenance of all process steps in generating MIS reports through SQL server reporting services. 
Involved in Data Migration and integration tasks.
Involved in creation and maintenance of various scheduled jobs and batch processes.

import and export from NAV to variety of other applications and databases; maintain and develop SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages to automate data flow across another database

Navision ERP system.
